title: 第一卷 第261章 调教第一卷 第260章 元婴巅峰一百次
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉
content_zh:
暗红色的阵壁在河谷上空缓缓流转，如同一座与世隔绝的铁笼。
阵中，李寒山刚刚完成第一百次耕耘。
纯阳之气在他经脉中奔涌不息，将方才从她体内汲取的化神本源一丝一缕地炼化、沉淀。
元婴九层的根基在这一个月的高强度双修中变得更加坚实，虽然距离元婴巅峰还有一线之隔，但差距已经微乎其微了。
阴灵月躺在地上，灰色长袍散乱地堆在身侧，露出大片白皙如玉的肌肤。她闭着眼，呼吸微弱，暗紫色的眼眸藏在垂落的发丝后面，看不出任何情绪。一个月的时间，她已经学会了用麻木来掩盖内心的翻涌。但今天不一样。
李寒山感知到小腹处传来一阵温热。
他分出一缕神识探入阳纹空间——那里，属于阴灵月的那朵花，三片花瓣同时绽放开来，散发出柔和的银色光芒。三片花开，可断奴之生机。他心念一动，那朵花的三片花瓣同时一颤。
阴灵月猛地睁开了眼。她的身体剧烈一僵，脸色瞬间变得惨白如纸。一只手猛地捂住小腹，暗紫色的眼眸中满是惊骇。
她感觉到一股无形的力量正从她小腹处升起，如同铁钳般死死扼住了她的生机。只要李寒山再动一下念头，她的心跳就会停止，她的生命就会戛然而止。
“你……你做了什么？”她的声音沙哑而颤抖，连尾音都在发颤。
李寒山伸手拨开她额前的碎发，露出那张苍白却依旧精致的脸。
他的声音平静：“你的生死，从此在我一念之间。那道纹路已经在你体内生了根，开了花。就算你恢复全盛时期的修为，也挣脱不了。”
阴灵月的身体剧烈颤抖起来。
她低下头，看着自己的小腹——那道银灰色的纹路正在缓缓隐去，但那种被扼住生机的感觉却清晰得如同烙在灵魂上的印记。
她试图调动体内那缕正在缓慢恢复的灵力去冲击那道纹路，却如同飞蛾扑火，刚一触碰便被弹了回来，连靠近都做不到。
“不可能……”
她的声音从齿缝间挤出来，沙哑中带着绝望，“我是化神……我修炼了数百年……怎么可能……”
“为什么不可能？”
李寒山调动阴纹，顿时，那朵花开放在阴灵月的体内，将她的生机牢牢的遏制。
阴灵月一颤。

这下，她的感受清晰了。
她的生机，确实被李寒山拽在了手中，生死在于李寒山一念之间。
她猛地抬起头，暗紫色的眼眸中翻涌着愤怒、不甘、屈辱，最终化作一片死寂的空茫。
她抬起手，想要抓住李寒山的衣襟，手臂却在半空中无力地垂下，连攥紧拳头的力气都使不上来。
李寒山看着她这副模样，心中没有太多波澜。
这一个月里，他早已摸清了她的底细——她体内的灵力在缓慢恢复，那些封禁在时间流逝下正在一丝一丝地松动。
如果再多给她一两个月，她完全有可能在某个夜深人静的时刻找到破绽，发动致命一击。
但现在已经没有必要了。花开三瓣之后，就算她恢复全盛，也翻不出他的手掌心。
“你原本打算在恢复灵力之后反击我。”他开口，语气平静得像是在陈述一件已经发生过的事，“你经脉中的灵力恢复速度，比正常被封禁的修士快了将近三成。说明你修炼的功法有自主运转的特性，连封禁都无法完全压制。”他蹲在她面前，看着她那双暗紫色的眼眸，“我没说错吧？”
阴灵月的嘴唇颤抖了一下，没有否认。
李寒山轻轻拥住她，纯阳之气涌入她的体内，温润而坚定地沿着那道阴纹的轨迹走了一圈。
阴灵月的身体猛地一颤，她能感觉到那股纯阳之气正在安抚那道扼住她生机的纹路，虽然无法消除它的存在，却让那种窒息般的压迫感减轻了几分。
“我不会杀你。”李寒山的声音平静，“我要你活着。活着当我的炉鼎，活着为我办事。只要你听话，我可以给你好处。”
他说着，将一缕更加精纯的纯阳之气渡入她体内，沿着经脉缓缓游走了一圈。那是他这一个月来从她体内汲取的化神本源重新炼化后的产物，品质比普通纯阳之气更加精纯。那股气息所过之处，阴灵月疲惫的经脉如同干裂的河床被雨水浸润，泛起一丝久违的温润感。
阴灵月的身体微微颤了一下，暗紫色的眼眸中闪过一丝极其复杂的情绪——有惊讶，有抗拒，还有一丝她极力压制却依旧泄露了痕迹的动摇。
她修炼了上千年，比任何人都清楚灵力的纯度对修为的重要性。那股纯阳之气的品质远超她的预料，若能持续获得这样的滋养，她的修为突破化神三层甚至化神四层，都指日可待。
content_en:
The dark red formation walls slowly flowed over the river valley, like an iron cage isolated from the world.
In the formation, Li Hanshan has just completed his 100th cultivation.
The pure Yang Qi surged endlessly in his meridians, refining and precipitating the source of divine transformation that he had just absorbed from her body.
The foundation of the ninth level of the Nascent Soul has become more solid during this month of high-intensity dual cultivation. Although there is still a thin line between the peak of the Nascent Soul, the gap is already minimal.
Yin Lingyue was lying on the ground, her gray robes piled randomly beside her, revealing a large area of ​​fair and jade-like skin. She closed her eyes and breathed weakly. Her dark purple eyes were hidden behind her hanging hair, showing no emotion. In a month, she had learned to use numbness to cover up her inner turmoil. But today is different.
Li Hanshan felt a warmth coming from his lower abdomen.
He separated a ray of consciousness and penetrated into the Yang pattern space - there, the three petals of the flower belonging to Yin Ling Yue bloomed at the same time, emitting a soft silver light. Three flowers bloom, which can cut off the slave's vitality. As he thought, the three petals of the flower trembled at the same time.
Yin Lingyue opened her eyes suddenly. Her body stiffened violently, and her face instantly turned pale as a sheet. One hand suddenly covered his lower abdomen, his dark purple eyes filled with horror.
She felt an invisible force rising from her lower abdomen, strangling her life like an iron pincer. As long as Li Hanshan has another thought, her heart will stop and her life will come to an abrupt end.
"You...what did you do?" Her voice was hoarse and trembling, even the last note was trembling.
Li Hanshan reached out and pushed away the broken hair from her forehead, revealing her pale but still delicate face.
His voice was calm: "Your life and death will depend on my thoughts from now on. That pattern has taken root and blossomed in your body. Even if you regain your cultivation level in your heyday, you still can't break free."
Yin Lingyue's body trembled violently.
She lowered her head and looked at her belly - the silver-gray lines were slowly disappearing, but the feeling of being strangled was as clear as a mark on her soul.
She tried to mobilize the slowly recovering spiritual power in her body to attack the lines, but like a moth to a flame, it was bounced back as soon as she touched it, and she couldn't even get close.
"Impossible..."
Her voice squeezed out from between her teeth, hoarse with despair, "I am the God of Transformation... I have been practicing for hundreds of years... How is it possible..."
"Why isn't it possible?"
Li Hanshan mobilized the Yin patterns, and immediately, the flower bloomed in Yin Lingyue's body, firmly containing her vitality.
Yin Lingyue trembled.
Now, her feelings became clear.
Her life was indeed held in Li Hanshan's hands, and her life and death depended on Li Hanshan's thoughts.
She raised her head suddenly, her dark purple eyes filled with anger, unwillingness, and humiliation, and finally turned into a dead silence.
She raised her hand, trying to grab Li Hanshan's shirt, but her arms hung weakly in mid-air, unable to even tighten her fists.
Li Hanshan looked at her like this and didn't feel too much in his heart.
In this month, he has already figured out her details - the spiritual power in her body is slowly recovering, and the restrictions are loosening bit by bit with the passage of time.
If she had been given another month or two, she might have found a flaw in the dead of night and launched a fatal blow.
But it's no longer necessary. After the flower blooms three petals, even if she returns to full bloom, she still cannot turn it out of his palm.
"You originally planned to fight back after you recovered your spiritual power." He spoke in a calm tone, as if he was stating something that had already happened. "The recovery speed of the spiritual power in your meridians is nearly 30% faster than that of a normal banned monk. This means that the skills you practice have the characteristics of autonomous operation, and even the ban cannot completely suppress it." He squatted in front of her and looked into her dark purple eyes., "Am I right?"
Yin Lingyue's lips trembled but she did not deny it.
Li Hanshan hugged her gently, and the pure Yang energy poured into her body, gently but firmly following the path of the Yin lines.
Yin Lingyue's body trembled suddenly, and she could feel the pure Yang Qi soothing the lines that were strangling her vitality. Although it could not eliminate its existence, it made the suffocating oppression feel a little lighter.
"I won't kill you." Li Hanshan's voice was calm, "I want you to live. Live to be my furnace and live to do things for me. As long as you are obedient, I can give you benefits."
As he spoke, he transferred a ray of purer pure Yang energy into her body and slowly traveled around along the meridians. It was the product of re-refining the spirit-forming origin he had absorbed from her body over the past month, and its quality was purer than ordinary pure Yang energy. Wherever that breath passed, Yin Lingyue's tired meridians were like a cracked river bed soaked by rain, giving off a sense of long-lost warmth.
Yin Lingyue's body trembled slightly, and a trace of extremely complex emotions flashed through her dark purple eyes - there was surprise, resistance, and a trace of wavering that she tried her best to suppress but still leaked.
She has been practicing for thousands of years and knows better than anyone else how important the purity of spiritual power is to cultivation. The quality of that pure yang energy far exceeded her expectations. If she could continue to receive such nourishment, it would be just around the corner for her to break through the third level of divine transformation or even the fourth level of divine transformation.
